recommendation: Implement comprehensive vaccine screening and administration
implementation_steps: Screen for vaccine eligibility during all patient encounters
Provide strong recommendations for needed vaccines
Use motivational interviewing to address vaccine hesitancy
Ensure bidirectional communication with immunization registries
evidence_summary: Pharmacist-led vaccination interventions have demonstrated significant improvements in vaccination rates across multiple studies, particularly when implementing screening protocols and standing orders.
citation: Addressing Common Barriers in Adult Immunizations
